purpose: Teach: ゴージャス/重荷/土星/母乳/モザイク/軍艦/パジャマ/タマネギ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがゴージャスなお茶会を開かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma held quite the fancy tea party.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight upward lilt on the name. Speaking as someone sharing something observed with affection. Gentle pacing, relaxed shoulders.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達の悩みが重荷にならないか心配だよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm worried my friend's problems might be too much for me to carry.
lines.style: Careful, hesitant articulation. Soft and serious for a six-year-old—he's genuinely thinking through this. Slight pause before 'carry' as if measuring the weight of the words. Steady eye contact, searching.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが土星の写真を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad showed me some photographs of Saturn.
lines.style: Gentle, present tone. Speaking as though relaying something she thinks will delight him. Warm cadence, unhurried. The voice of someone sharing a small joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お母さんの母乳でぼくは育ったって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard that I grew up drinking your milk.
lines.style: Direct, curious, matter-of-fact in the way only a six-year-old can be about biological facts. No embarrassment in his voice—just genuine wondering. Open, innocent phrasing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがモザイクタイルを買ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad picked up some mosaic tiles.
lines.style: Observational, gentle. Speaking as though mentioning something that might spark his interest. Warm undertone, natural pacing. The voice of someone noticing what her child might enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと軍艦の模型作りたい
lines.en: Mom, I really want to build a battleship model with Dad.
lines.style: Eager but not demanding. Bright, hopeful inflection on 'really.' Quick pace, forward energy. The enthusiasm of a child who's been thinking about this and wants her on board. Open and guileless.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新しいパジャマ買って来てくれたわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought home some new pajamas for you.
lines.style: Warm, pleased delivery. Light emphasis on 'new' as if delighted by the small thoughtfulness. Gentle smile in the voice. Natural, conversational pacing—she's sharing something kind that Dad did.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんとタマネギを収穫したよ
lines.en: Mom, me and Grandma harvested onions today!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Sharp opening on the first word. Quick pace, alive with the pride of accomplishment. The voice lifts slightly at the end—he's sharing something he's proud of, wants her to celebrate it too.
